title: Puppy in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#C68B59'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='13' ry='12' fill='#E8C39E'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='20' fill='#C68B59'/>

  <path d='M28 62 Q50 70 72 62 L72 68 Q50 76 28 68 Z' fill='#E53935'/>

  <path d='M36 64 Q50 69 64 64 L64 66 Q50 71 36 66 Z' fill='#FFCDD2'/>
